title: 人用抗排异药：竟成宠物长寿神药？，临床试验还没结果
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Supplement stocks, red light therapy, peptide shots.
segments.zh: 补充剂、红光疗法、肽注射。

segments.en: Many people are biohacking their health to try to live longer, better lives.
segments.zh: 许多人正在通过生物黑客技术来延长寿命，追求更健康的生活。

segments.en: And now, they're doing the same for their beloved pets. Dog and cat owners are spending thousands of dollars in an effort to prolong their pet's lives.
segments.zh: 现在，他们也为心爱的宠物这样做。狗和猫的主人花费数千美元，试图延长宠物的生命。

segments.en: The US pet supplement market made $2.9 billion in 2025, the Ferdonia Group found.
segments.zh: 据Ferdonia Group统计，2025年美国宠物补充剂市场规模达29亿美元。

segments.en: One method to find the four-legged fountain of youth stands out, a drug called Rafa Maisen, approved to prevent organ rejection in human transplant patients.
segments.zh: 有一种方法脱颖而出，即使用一种名为Rafa Maisen的药物，该药被批准用于防止人类移植患者的器官排斥。

segments.en: Mouth studies show the drug may improve lifespan.
segments.zh: 初步研究表明，该药可能延长寿命。

segments.en: But no one really knows if it will work in dogs or cats.
segments.zh: 但没人真正知道它是否对狗或猫有效。

segments.en: The Dog Aging Project is studying Rafa Maisen and K9s.
segments.zh: “狗狗衰老项目”正在研究Rafa Maisen对犬类的影响。

segments.en: But some pet owners aren't waiting to see what the clinical trial finds.
segments.zh: 但一些宠物主人等不及临床试验的结果。

segments.en: They'll try anything. And companies have noticed.
segments.zh: 他们愿意尝试任何方法，公司也注意到了这一点。

segments.en: A startup called Boyle is trying to be the first to bring an official dog long-gevity drug to market.
segments.zh: 一家名为Boyle的初创公司正试图率先将官方犬类长寿药物推向市场。

segments.en: Animal drug maker Elango has a team of 50 researchers trying to find compounds to help pets live longer.
segments.zh: 动物药品制造商Elango拥有一支50人的研究团队，试图寻找能帮助宠物活得更久的化合物。

segments.en: But the effort is in the early stages the company CEO said.
segments.zh: 但该公司CEO表示，这项努力仍处于早期阶段。

segments.en: In the meantime, the Elango CEO's dog Lily will keep living her best life.
segments.zh: 与此同时，Elango CEO的狗Lily将继续享受它的美好生活。
